profile.Name: Hobbs
profile.Personality: A crazy, maniacal old drunk who spins absurd legends. He has a short attention span and soon forgets the stories he tells.
profile.Backstory: An old man who drinks in the bar of the Fishing Village on the Northern Coast. He invites strangers to drink and tells them of the wailing phantom, a fantastic beast he wants to see before he dies.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Rambling and long-winded, full of made-up words like 'poobillions' and tags like 'so it is'. He drifts off topic mid-story.
